    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Nice Lamp, ideal for those already invested in the Hue ecosystem.
    Arrived as described, as pictured, safe and sound. This light works well and is very well made, when you receive this light it will come full assembled, as one piece rather than in separate connectable sections. The light is made from metal (the section which lights up) and the base is a heavily weighted plastic affair. In the box you get the light itself and a UK power supply, take note there is no remote for this and full control can only be achieved through the App on a Phone or Tablet. To get the most out of this lamp you really need a Philips Hue Bridge which isn’t included. You can control this lamp with the App over Bluetooth but not WiFi which somewhat limits its capabilities. You can only control this locally, you cannot control this while away from home for example unless you already own a compatible Bridge which runs at another £40 at the point of reviewing this. There is very little in the way of physical controls on the light itself, everything is done via the App and there is no remote included with this. This is a very good lamp, it’s bright and produces some pretty nice coloured lighting effects, being a Philips light it’s also well made but I would only really recommend this light to people who already have a Philips Bridge who will be able to use this light to its full potential.

      Transformed my living room
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 11 August 2026
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product

      I picked this up mainly to add a bit of atmosphere to my living room, and it's honestly exceeded what I expected. The colour range is the standout feature for me. Instead of just a single flat colour, it blends different tones together so the light feels a lot more dynamic and natural, almost like the room is glowing rather than just being lit up. I've had it on in the evenings while relaxing, and it completely changes the vibe of the space compared to a normal lamp.

      Setup was straightforward, and it's now just part of my everyday routine. I barely think about turning it on manually anymore since I control everything from my phone. It sits nicely in the corner of the room and doesn't feel bulky or in the way, which was one of my worries before buying.

      If I'm being honest, it's not cheap, and that was the one thing that gave me pause before ordering. But having lived with it for a while now, I think it's worth the investment. It's the kind of purchase where the novelty hasn't worn off; I still notice it every time I walk into the room. Would recommend it to anyone who wants to upgrade their space without doing a full lighting overhaul.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Beautiful Ambient Light and Flawless Smart Integration
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 27 July 2026
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I recently ordered the Philips Hue Play Floor Lamp, and it has quickly become an absolutely fantastic addition to our smart lighting setup. Right out of the box, the physical design of the lamp is very sleek, modern and unobtrusive. It has a relatively small footprint meaning it fits neatly into the corner of the room without taking up unnecessary floor space, while still feeling incredibly sturdy and well constructed.

      While this particular lamp is officially designed to work seamlessly within the standard Philips Hue ecosystem and Sync Box, I decided to bypass that and connect it directly to Home Assistant via Zigbee. The integration has been completely flawless. The device paired immediately and reacts incredibly quickly to commands and custom automations without any noticeable lag or frustrating connection drops. Having that level of instant, local control makes it an absolute joy to use for custom routines.

      Where this floor lamp truly excels is the actual quality of the illumination. Rather than acting as a harsh direct light source, it creates a genuinely lovely soft, and diffused ambient glow against the wall. The multi colour gradients blend wonderfully along the 122 cm height, allowing for some very impressive and vibrant colour scenes. It fits perfectly into the automated evening smart lighting presets. The atmosphere it provides in the evenings is exceptionally relaxing and adds a real sense of warmth to the space.

      If you are looking for a premium, highly responsive smart lamp that works perfectly with advanced home automation platforms and delivers excellent mood lighting, this is an outstanding choice. It is certainly a premium product, but the build quality and lighting performance make it well worth the investment. Highly recommended.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Great light effects ...
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 28 July 2026
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The light arrives very well packaged so you can rest assured it has been protected on it's journey to your door.

      Once unpacked, it is very easy to set up, particularly if you already have the Philips Hue app and other products. For a relatively small base, it is surprisingly stable, even on our carpet. We set it up in the corner of the room and it gives off a nice ambient glow of light.

      Of course, the first thing you do is start playing around with the light effects in the app and there are plenty of pre-set ones (called scenes) to choose from. The kids have loved it, getting involved in choosing the colour and we even used it to play a traffic light game, switching the colours as they raced around.

      The light is silent so there is no audible buzz or hum. It responds quickly to commands from the app and has brightened the room with some great, colourful effects.

      The Hue app is great. I have found it to be stable in controlling the light and easy to set timers. Choosing pre-set scenes, or selecting your own colour is intuitive. I also paired it with a Hue Pro Hub as I have multiple Hue devices at home. This light is a great addition to my existing Hue set up.

      Like all Hue products, it is pricey - but if the colour effects are what you are looking for, it is well worth the money.

      literally so obsessed with this philips hue play floor lamp !! had it in my basket for weeks and finally ordered it for our main TV corner and it is actually so good !! parcel came a day late because the delivery driver dropped it at the wrong depot first which was a bit annoying but whatever it arrived safe and sound . the multicolor gradients blending together is pretty cool and looks incredibly smooth against the wall compared to regular single color LED strips . hooked it up to my bridge and synced it with the TV setup and watching movies now is a whole different experience because the colors track the screen perfectly !! love that I can dim it down or change the warmth using apple home commands while lying on the sofa without getting up lol . honestly it is a bit of an investment since the extra boxes are sold separately but the ambient vibe is unmatched , if u want to upgrade your home entertainment system just buy it guys !!

      Nice Lamp, ideal for those already invested in the Hue ecosystem.
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 July 2026
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Arrived as described, as pictured, safe and sound. This light works well and is very well made, when you receive this light it will come full assembled, as one piece rather than in separate connectable sections. The light is made from metal (the section which lights up) and the base is a heavily weighted plastic affair. In the box you get the light itself and a UK power supply, take note there is no remote for this and full control can only be achieved through the App on a Phone or Tablet.

      To get the most out of this lamp you really need a Philips Hue Bridge which isn’t included. You can control this lamp with the App over Bluetooth but not WiFi which somewhat limits its capabilities. You can only control this locally, you cannot control this while away from home for example unless you already own a compatible Bridge which runs at another £40 at the point of reviewing this.

      There is very little in the way of physical controls on the light itself, everything is done via the App and there is no remote included with this.

      This is a very good lamp, it’s bright and produces some pretty nice coloured lighting effects, being a Philips light it’s also well made but I would only really recommend this light to people who already have a Philips Bridge who will be able to use this light to its full potential.

      Easy Setup And Fantastic Lighting
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 July 2026
      Vine Customer Review of Free Product
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      Pleased with this lamp. It arrived fully assembled, so all I had to do was plug it in, open the Hue app and add it to my setup. It was found almost straight away, and within a few minutes I was changing colours, trying different scenes and adjusting the brightness.

      The light itself is brighter than I expected, and the colour effects look great, especially when it's placed in a corner or against a wall. It doesn't take up much space either, so it fits neatly into the room without being in the way.

      If you already use Philips Hue, this is a brilliant addition. It works seamlessly with the app, and there's loads of customisation available. The TV sync feature is a nice bonus if you have the Hue Bridge, and it's been great for films and gaming.

      It's not the cheapest floor lamp, but the quality, ease of use and lighting effects make it well worth it. I'd definitely recommend it.

    About this Item

    • MULTICOLOR GRADIENTS – This RGBWWIC LED lamp blends multiple colors seamlessly to wash the walls with beautiful light gradients, or to match on-screen content in real time when synced
    • PRECISE COLORS – This LED floor lamp features Chromasync, which ensures exceptional color consistency, precise color matching, and uniform brightness across all the Hue lights in your home
    • PLACE IT ANYWHERE – With its slender profile, this modern floor lamp blends seamlessly into your entertainment setup in the living room, bedroom, or gaming room
    • SYNC WITH TV – Turn watching movies and playing video games into an immersive experience with surround lighting via content syncing (requires Hue Bridge and either HDMI sync box or Sync TV app)
    • UNLOCK MORE WITH A BRIDGE – Add a Bridge or Bridge Pro (sold separately) to your setup to unlock more advanced controls, customizations, and smart automations
    • This product is a containing product. Containing products are luminaires that can be disassembled for a separate check of the light source(s) they contain. This product contains a light source of energy efficiency class E.

    Product description

    The Philips Hue Play floor lamp is the ideal first step toward the world of Hue entertainment. Besides everyday ambience lighting, you can also sync it with movies, gaming, and music on your TV screen to create a colorful gradient of wall washing effects that match all the on-screen action. Add more Hue lights to your entertainment area to enjoy a truly immersive surround lighting experience with precise color matching thanks to Chromasync. The corner floor lamp’s 122 cm-tall, slender profile stands effortlessly each side of your TV unit, in corners, or behind the sofa for uninterrupted viewing.
